justification: The boy from New Jersey wears a tag today that says what everyone already knows about him this week, and I will not pretend a locked door is open simply because I am fond of the room behind it — Garrett Wilson rests, and Jadarian Price, who has grown quietly in a garden nobody was watching, takes the flex in his place; that is not a hunch, that is merely arithmetic dressed as patience. Emanuel Wilson stays at the second running spot though the ledger calls him thin — the ledger describes what has happened, and I am rather more interested in what has not. Jayden Daniels, Jonathan Taylor, Chris Olave, Tyler Warren, Parker Washington already locked by his own clock, Spencer Shrader, and a Denver defense I have no reason to doubt — nine sentences, one page, and I find I have nothing further to add to it. Patricia keeps a record of every season; I keep a record of every seed. We shall see this Sunday which one blooms first.
